final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin iout vdd vss
* input branch: Iin -> iin (cascode gate node) -> R -> d3 (bottom gate node) -> M3 -> a -> M1 -> vss
R1  iin d3  12000
M3  d3  iin a   vss nfet W=10 L=0.5 m=2
M1  a   d3  vss vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=2
* output branch (identical devices, ratio 1)
M4  iout iin b  vss nfet W=10 L=0.5 m=2
M2  b    d3 vss vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=2
.ends dut
